symptom: Zoom flicker on transition, 1px border thickening to 2px, and initial fail to maximize in Focus Mode
root_cause: CSS Zoom scales borders, layout settling delay, and transition interference
fix: Implement non-scaling border (calc(1px/zoom)), zoom-pending visibility toggle, and re-render with settlement delay
avoid: Do not manually call fitting logic without double-rAF or settlement delay

issue: Legacy domain name remained across storage and UI layers
symptom: The interface represented a pharmacy but API and JSON still used a different business-domain key
root_cause: A UI-only rename preserved the old storage contract
fix: Rename the domain key consistently across API, JSON records, frontend state, reports, export and documentation
avoid: Do not rename only visible labels when a domain concept is shared across layers
regression_checks: reports and export load migrated data
legacy business name absent from tracked files

issue: Dashboard needed a mobile-friendly public mode behind reverse proxy
symptom: Desktop dashboard worked locally but there was no explicit mobile view switch and no lightweight health endpoint for NPM/service checks
root_cause: The UI only relied on responsive CSS and the app had no production-oriented runtime contract
fix: Add a persisted Desktop/Mobile view switch, render a card-based mobile list from the same data source, and expose /health with env-driven host/port/debug settings
avoid: Do not fork the data model or require a separate mobile app just to support phone usage
regression_checks: CRUD and exports still use the same records

issue: JSON-backed app needed a safe macOS service template
symptom: The app should run as a persistent Mac mini service behind Nginx Proxy Manager without exposing the app directly
root_cause: JSON file storage is fragile under concurrent workers and should be kept behind a single localhost-bound process
fix: Use launchd with a localhost bind, one gunicorn worker, and a documented env file so NPM can proxy to the service safely
avoid: Do not expose the app directly on the public network or add multiple workers while monthly data is still stored as JSON
